system_prompt_style.note: Only README available; prompt is user-supplied via AgentPrompt and scoped services; mechanism not shown in code. Could be dynamically_composed (tools from registry).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent discovers its services from the registry, scopes its tools to their endpoints, and maintains conversation memory in the store.
env_context_strategy.note: Not a code-repo agent; environment knowledge comes from tool calls to registered services. Closest value.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Long-running agents can opt into `AgentCompactMemory(maxMessages, keepRecent)`: older turns are collapsed into a deterministic summary, recent turns stay verbatim
